message: Claude, connected to your sync server, now answers in your own time zone, so in the evening it no longer reads tomorrow’s tasks as today’s, and a date it sets lands on the day you meant. It can also plan your day around your meetings, even out a heavy week, add a whole pasted list at once, edit many tasks in one go after showing you the changes, look at how your habits are going, summarize what you got done, and find the setting you’re asking about.
